description: This class includes the manufacture of basic chemicals such as industrial gases, inorganic and organic chemicals, and petrochemicals.
includes: manufacture of industrial gases: liquid air, compressed air, refrigerant gases, mixed industrial gases, inert gases, oxygen, nitrogen, hydrogen, carbon dioxide
manufacture of dyes and pigments from any source in basic form
manufacture of other basic inorganic chemicals: acids, alkalis, salts
manufacture of other basic organic chemicals: alcohols, glycols, aldehydes, ketones, carboxylic acids, phenols
manufacture of petrochemicals: ethylene, propylene, butylene, benzene, toluene, xylene
manufacture of activated carbon, carbon black, graphite
excludes: manufacture of refined petroleum products, see 1920
manufacture of fertilizers and nitrogen compounds, see 2012
manufacture of plastics in primary forms, see 2013
